title: Touhou Kishinjou ~ Double Dealing Character - Bamboo Forest of the Full Moon
description:
The stage 3 theme from Touhou Kishinjou ~ Double Dealing Character, where, as the title implies, you're flying through a forest of bamboo while a full moon is out.

It's a fast-paced and energetic song with the Theme of Eastern Story leitmotif in it.
